# VerticalFoundry

> VerticalFoundry is a brand of Quant Data Intelligence LLC, developing practical industry-specific business tools for independent service entrepreneurs; the initial product catalog is being prepared.

Owned and operated by Quant Data Intelligence LLC, a United States limited liability company. Founder: Alexandru Stoica. This site is informational; current or future product availability must be established from actual Etsy listings.
